# Auto-generated theses

Written by `scripts/autonomous_cycle.py`. When the daily cycle REFUTES a book it
automatically grades that book INVERTED and, if the inverse clears every
promotion bar (EV>0 at real fees, both OOS halves >0, survives 25bps,
matched-null mc_p<0.05), banks it here as a candidate.

A counterfactual on a dead ledger is a HYPOTHESIS, not a forward verdict — the
precedent is 2026-07-20, where blanket inversion failed but ~1 in 4 refuted
cells hid a real inverse edge. Each entry needs a bounded recorder and its own
forward n before it sees capital.
